# Trafa Pharmaceutical Inc

> Trafa Pharma is a wholesale pharmaceutical and nutraceutical ingredients supplier specializing in herbal powders, vitamins, extracts, and cosmeceutical components for B2B procurement.

Based in Chicopee, Massachusetts, Trafa Pharma serves manufacturers and formulators with a comprehensive catalog of pharmaceutical-grade ingredients including standardized plant extracts, organic herbal powders, fruit powders, vitamins, and specialty compounds like NMN and 5-MTHF. The platform features secure payment processing, user authentication, and detailed quality compliance information.
